agent_notes: NIRF 2025 OverallRankingALL.html independently lists the exact institution name with Prayagraj and Uttar Pradesh.
The official homepage and programme/admission pages were fetched from prsuniv.ac.in and the university's linked prsuprayagraj.in admissions host.
Normal TLS first produced the managed proxy's self-signed certificate-chain error; curl --insecure was then used only for public GETs to the expected official/search hostnames.
The central CoursesPRSU.aspx catalogue was supplemented by the official 2026-27 admission bulletins, which add current postgraduate diplomas and professional agriculture specializations.
The similar domain prsu.ac.in was rejected because its homepage identifies Pt. Ravishankar Shukla University in Raipur, Chhattisgarh.

Duration and eligibility are null where the official catalogue did not explicitly state them, including the doctoral catalogue entries and catalogue-only Biotechnology, Home Science and Public Administration entries.
